create_RenderMLP: create a RenderMLP instance with configurable density and radiance MLP networks for 3D scene rendering
run_RenderMLP_forward: run the RenderMLP forward pass to compute densities, radiance features, and viewpoint-independent features from input features and view directions
get_RenderMLP_normals: get surface normals from 3D points using the RenderMLP density network and automatic differentiation
build_HoloVoxelGridImplicitFunction: build a HoloVoxelGridImplicitFunction with configurable resolution, volume extent, and render MLP for implicit 3D scene representation
run_HoloVoxelGridImplicitFunction_forwar: run the HoloVoxelGridImplicitFunction forward pass to sample voxel grid features along rays and decode densities and colour features
